# Baryon AX

> On-premises, model-agnostic AI agent platform for enterprise grounded chat, document knowledge, tacit-knowledge capture, and governance.

Baryon AX is an open-source Basic Core (MIT) that runs with Docker Compose. It connects OpenAI-compatible models (Ollama, vLLM, or a custom gateway), ingests documents (HWP/HWPX/PDF/Office/images), retrieves with Qdrant + FastEmbed, and returns answers with source citations. The full-stack profile adds PostgreSQL, Redis, Langfuse, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and Mem0.

## Key facts

- Version: 0.6.0 (first release, 2026-11-13)
- License: MIT
- Deployment: on-premises / air-gapped capable
- Basic Core: 2 vCPU, 4GB RAM, 10GB disk, no GPU
- Full stack: 8 vCPU, 16GB RAM (32GB recommended), 100GB disk
- Validated models: Ollama qwen2.5:7b, vLLM Qwen3.5-27B on B300 GPU 7
- Security CI: every PR runs security-sweep; P0/P1 block merge; weekly image/SBOM/gitleaks scans

## Start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/baryonlabs/baryon-ax.git
cd baryon-ax
cp .env.example .env
docker compose up --build
```

Open http://localhost:3001. The demo-local model works without an API key.

## Notes

- The development identity headers (X-User-Id, X-Organization-Id, X-Roles) are not production authentication. Replace them with OIDC/JWT before exposing a deployment.
- The security scan is a baseline for known vulnerabilities, not a certification. Logic flaws require SAST and human review.
